Lecture notes for **Process Dynamics and Control (공정제어)**. Slides are Quarto/reveal.js decks; every calculation is reproduced in a Python notebook (MATLAB code is shown alongside). Green chips open the interactive explorers on their own page.

{{< include _chapters.md >}}

**How to use**

- **Slides (HTML)** — the main version: interactive widgets, Python/MATLAB code tabs with copy buttons. Press `F` for full screen, `S` for speaker view, `Esc` for the slide overview.
- **PDF** — one slide per page, for tablets (GoodNotes, Notability, …).
- **Handout** — A4, three slides per page with ruled note space, for printing.
- **Colab** — opens the chapter notebook in Google Colab; run all cells to reproduce the figures.
- **[Slide contents](contents.qmd)** lists every slide (searchable) and **[Homework problems](problems.qmd)** collects the problems of all chapters.
